steps.run: (() => { const picker = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Attachment files"]'); const transfer = new DataTransfer(); transfer.items.add(new File(['First line.\r\nSecond line.'], 'notes.txt', {type: 'text/plain'})); picker.files = transfer.files; picker.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); return { pickerAcceptsFile: true }; })()

(() => { const transfer = new DataTransfer(); const pixel = Uint8Array.from(atob('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mNkYAAAAAYAAjCB0C8AAAAASUVORK5CYII='), c => c.charCodeAt(0)); transfer.items.add(new File([pixel], 'pixel.png', {type:'image/png'})); transfer.setData('text/plain','Distinct pasted text.'); transfer.setData('text/html',''); document.querySelector('textarea[aria-label=Message]').dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent('paste', {bubbles:true, cancelable:true, clipboardData:transfer})); return { imagePasteDispatched: true }; })()

(() => { const transfer = new DataTransfer(); transfer.items.add(new File(['%PDF-1.7\nSaved original.'], 'paper.pdf', {type:'application/pdf'})); document.querySelector('fieldset[aria-label="Message box"]').dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('drop',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,dataTransfer:transfer})); return { binaryDropDispatched: true }; })()

(async () => { for (let attempt=0; attempt<150 && (document.body.innerText.includes('Uploading') || !document.body.innerText.includes('File path included')); attempt+=1) await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,100)); return { textForm:document.body.innerText.includes('Text included'), fileForm:document.body.innerText.includes('File path included'), imageReachesModel:!document.body.innerText.includes('This model receives the image details, but not its pixels.'), distinctTextPreserved:document.querySelector('textarea[aria-label=Message]').value === 'Distinct pasted text.', oneImage:[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(button=>button.textContent.includes('pixel.png') && button.textContent.includes('Image')).length === 1 }; })()

(async () => { for (let attempt=0;attempt<120 && !document.querySelector('button[aria-label=Stop]');attempt+=1) await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,50)); const transfer=new DataTransfer();transfer.items.add(new File(['Queued attachment.'],'queued.txt',{type:'text/plain'}));const picker=document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Attachment files"]');picker.files=transfer.files;picker.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));return { replying:!!document.querySelector('button[aria-label=Stop]') };})()

(async()=>{for(let attempt=0;attempt<150 && document.querySelector('button[aria-label=Stop]');attempt+=1)await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,100));return { held:document.body.innerText.includes('Resume to send.'), attachmentWaiting:document.body.innerText.includes('queued.txt'), steeringHeld:document.body.innerText.includes('Steer while attachments wait.') };})()

(async()=>{for(let attempt=0;attempt<200 && (document.querySelector('button[aria-label=Stop]') || document.body.innerText.includes('Waiting messages'));attempt+=1){const approval=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(button=>button.textContent.trim()==='Allow for every chat of the Default profile');if(approval)approval.click();await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,100));}return { resumed:!document.body.innerText.includes('Waiting messages'), queuedAttachmentDelivered:document.querySelector('main').innerText.includes('queued.txt') };})()
